qe: Who presides over the 'Joint Sitting' of the two Houses of Parliament under Article 108?
qh: संसद के दोनों सदनों की 'संयुक्त बैठक' की अध्यक्षता कौन करता है?
o: The Union Prime Minister
The President of India
The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
The Vice-President of India
e: Article 108 ke anusaar jab kisi sadharan vidheyak (ordinary bill) par dono sadan (Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha) mein matbhed ho jaaye, to rashtrapati dono ke sanmilit baithak (joint sitting) bulwa sakte hain. Is baithak ki adhyakshta (presiding) Lok Sabha ka Adhyaksh (Speaker) karta hai - unki gairhaazri (absence) mein Upaadhyaksh, phir Rajya Sabha ka Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Chairman), phir koi senior sadasya. Sanmilit baithak mein kisi bhi vidheyak par faisla bahumat (majority) se hota hai, aur kyunki Lok Sabha ke sadasy zyada hote hain, aam taur par sadharan vidheyak wahi paas ho jaate hain jahan Lok Sabha ki raay ho. Note: Money Bill aur Article 368 wale samvidhan sanshodhan vidheyak par joint sitting nahi hoti. Exam point: joint sitting = Article 108, adhyakshta Speaker; ye sirf ordinary bill ke deadlock par hoti hai.

qe: Under Article 109, in which House of Parliament can a 'Money Bill' be introduced?
qh: 'धन विधेयक' केवल कहाँ पेश किया जा सकता है?
o: The Rajya Sabha exclusively
Either House of Parliament
Only in a Joint Sitting of both Houses
The Lok Sabha exclusively
e: Article 109 ke anusaar 'Money Bill' (dhan vidheyak) keval Lok Sabha (janta ke sadan) mein hi prastut kiya ja sakta hai - Rajya Sabha mein nahi. Money Bill par Rajya Sabha ke paas sirf 14 din ki samay-seema (limit) hoti hai, usmein sanshodhan ka adhikar bhi nahi, aur wo use accept kare ya reject kare, vaisa hi loksabha ka faisla maana jaata hai. Kyunki dhan (money) ka niyantran janata ke pratinidhiyon ke paas hona chahiye, isliye ye vyavastha hai. Financial Bill Category I prastut Karne se pehle rashtrapati ki sifarish chahiye, aur wo bhi keval Lok Sabha mein aata hai. Exam point: Money Bill = keval Lok Sabha, Article 109, Rajya Sabha ke paas 14 din + koi sanshodhan adhikar nahi.

qe: What is the constitutional 'Quorum' required to constitute a sitting of either House of Parliament under Article 100?
qh: संसद के किसी भी सदन की बैठक के लिए आवश्यक 'कोरम' क्या है?
o: One-third (1/3rd) of total members
One-tenth (1/10th) of the total number of members of the House
Fixed at 50 members regardless of the House
One-fifth (1/5th) of the total members
e: Article 100 ke anusaar kisi bhi sadan ki baithak ki gyarh (quorum) us sadan ke kul sadasyon ki 1/10 hissa (one-tenth) hoti hai - yani Lok Sabha mein lagbhag 55 aur Rajya Sabha mein 25 sadasy. Iska matlab ye hai ki agar kisi samay 1/10 se kam sadasy maujood hon, to adhyaksh ya koi bhi sadasya 'quorum' ka mudda utha sakta hai aur baithak ko sthagit (adjourn) karna padta hai. Sankhya (50 ya 1/3) wale vikalp galat hain kyunki samvidhan mein saaf roop se 1/10 likha hai. Exam point: quorum = kul sadasyata ka 1/10 (Article 100); isse kam hone par baithak nahi ho sakti.

qe: Why is the Rajya Sabha constitutionally referred to as a 'Permanent House' under Article 83?
qh: संसद के किस सदन को 'स्थायी सदन' कहा जाता है?
o: Because it exercises emergency financial veto powers
Because its members have lifetime tenure
Because it is not subject to dissolution, and one-third of its members retire every second year
Because its decisions cannot be reviewed by the Supreme Court
e: Article 83(1) ke anusaar Rajya Sabha ek sthir (permanent) sadan hai jo kabhi bhi bhangi (dissolve) nahi hoti. Iska karan ye hai ki iske sadasy 6 saal ke liye chune jaate hain aur har do saal mein ek-tihai (one-third) sadasya sewa-mukt (retire) hote hain - matlab sadan kabhi khaali nahi hoti, wo sirf navin (renew) hoti rehti hai; iska kaaryakal (term) khatm nahi hota. Iske vipreet Lok Sabha ka kaaryakal 5 saal ka hota hai aur usse samay se pehle bhanga ja sakta hai. Rajya Sabha ki vyavastha America ki Senate se prerit hai. Exam point: Rajya Sabha = permanent house (dissolve nahi hoti), 1/3 sadasy har 2 saal mein retire; tenure 6 saal.

qe: What is the total membership and inter-house composition of the Public Accounts Committee (PAC)?
qh: 'लोक लेखा समिति' (PAC) में कितने सदस्य होते हैं?
o: 15 members from Lok Sabha only
20 members (10 from LS and 10 from RS)
30 members from Lok Sabha only
22 members (15 from Lok Sabha and 7 from Rajya Sabha)
e: Public Accounts Committee (PAC) mein kul 22 sadasya hote hain - 15 Lok Sabha se aur 7 Rajya Sabha se, jinka chunav sadanon ke sadasyon se (proportional representation) hota hai. PAC ka kaam CAG (Comptroller and Auditor General) ki report ke aadhar par sarkar ke kharchon ki jaanch karna hai, aur ye jaanch ke baad apni report Lok Sabha mein pesh karti hai. Iski adhyakshta (chairmanship) aam taur par vipaksh (opposition) ke sadasya ko milti hai; PAC ki raay 'unanimous' hoti hai (matbhed ke samay adhyaksh ki raay nirdharak hoti hai). Exam point: PAC = 22 members (15 LS + 7 RS); COPU ka bhi composition 22 (15+7) hai.

qe: At what specific time does 'Zero Hour' customarily commence in the daily proceedings of the Lok Sabha?
qh: संसद में 'शून्य काल' किस समय शुरू होता है?
o: At 11:00 AM at the start of sitting
At 2:00 PM after lunch recess
During the last hour of business
Immediately after Question Hour at 12:00 Noon
e: 'Zero Hour' kisi samvidhan ya niyam-pustika (rule book) mein likha hua samay nahi hai - ye ek bharatiya parliamentary parampara hai jo 1962 se shuru hui. Ye Question Hour ke turant baad, yani 12:00 baje (bara bajkar) shuru hoti hai aur lagbhag 1 ghante tak chalti hai; ismein bina pehle soochna (notice) diye turant shaandhar (urgent) jan-jeevan ke mudde utaaye jaate hain. Kyunki ye samay 'shoonya' (zero) niyam se shuru hota hai, isliye ise Zero Hour kehte hain. Note ki shadaant (fixed) samay aur avadhi dono badal sakte hain. Exam point: Zero Hour = Question Hour ke turant baad (12 baje) - bina notice, urgent mudde; ye samvidhan mein nahi, riwaj (convention) hai.

qe: Under Article 312, which House of Parliament possesses the exclusive federal prerogative to initiate the creation of a new All-India Service?
qh: अनुच्छेद 312 राज्यसभा को क्या बनाने की विशेष शक्ति देता है?
o: Creation of one or more All-India Services through a two-thirds majority resolution
Initiation of national emergency proclamations
Creation of new autonomous territorial zones
Certification of union money bills
e: Article 312 ke anusaar agar Rajya Sabha apne upasthit evam matdan karne wale sadasyon ke do-tihai (2/3) bahumat se prastav (resolution) paas kare ki desh ke hit mein ek naya All-India Service banaya jaana chahiye, to Parliament kanoon bana kar aisi seva ban sakti hai. Ismein khaas baat yahi hai ki nayi All-India Service banane ki shakti Rajya Sabha ke paas hai (Lok Sabha ke paas nahi) - kyunki isse rajya ke kshetraadhikar (states' rights) par asar padega, aur Rajya Sabha rajyaon ka pratinidhi sadan hai. IAS, IPS aur Indian Forest Service pehle se hain (Article 312 ke teht). Exam point: nayi All-India Service = Rajya Sabha ka 2/3 resolution (Article 312) + Parliament ka kanoon.

qe: Who possesses the final, non-justiciable constitutional authority to certify whether a bill is a 'Money Bill' under Article 110?
qh: कौन तय करता है कि कोई विधेयक 'धन विधेयक' है या नहीं?
o: The Union Finance Minister
The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
The President of India
The Chief Justice of India
e: 'Money Bill hai ya nahi' - is par antim (final) aur nyayik jaanch se pare (non-justiciable) nirnay Lok Sabha ke Adhyaksh (Speaker) ka hota hai. Article 110 ke anusaar koi vidheyak Money Bill hai ya nahi, is par Speaker ka nirnay antim maana jaata hai; rashtrapati, vitta mantri ya mukhya nyayadhish ka koi role nahi hota. Speaker jab pramanit (certify) kar dete hain ki koi vidheyak Money Bill hai, to uske baad wo Rajya Sabha ki sifarish (recommendation) ke saath aage badhta hai. Iske baad bhi kuchh vaigyanikon ne Speaker ke is adhikar par sawaal uthaye hain (Rojer Mathew case), par samvidhan ke anusaar faisla Speaker ka hi hai. Exam point: Money Bill par antim nirnay = Speaker (Article 110), ye non-justiciable hai.

qe: The Estimates Committee of Parliament draws its entire membership from which House?
qh: 'प्राक्कलन समिति' किन सदस्यों से बनी होती है?
o: Nominated technical financial experts only
Exclusively from the Rajya Sabha
Both Houses of Parliament proportionally
Exclusively from the Lok Sabha (30 members)
e: Estimates Committee (Prachalan Samiti) ke saare 30 sadasya keval Lok Sabha se liye jaate hain - Rajya Sabha ka koi sadasya ismein nahi hota. Iska kaam sarkar ke varshik (annual) estimates ko jaanchna aur sujhav (economy) dena hai, taaki sansad ko kharch ka samuchit nirnay lekar aaye. Iske vipreet PAC (Public Accounts Committee) aur COPU (Committee on Public Undertakings) mein dono sadanon ke sadasya (15 LS + 7 RS = 22) hote hain. Estimates Committee sansad ki sabse badi committee hai (30 sadasya) aur ise 'Lok Sabha ki aankh' kaha jaata hai. Exam point: Estimates Committee = keval Lok Sabha (30 sadasy); PAC/COPU = dono sadan (22 = 15+7).

qe: Following the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, what is the maximum number of directly elected seats in the Lok Sabha?
qh: लोकसभा में निर्वाचित सदस्यों की अधिकतम संख्या कितनी है?
o: 552 members
250 members
530 members
543 members currently elected (550 maximum elective capacity)
e: 104th samvidhan sanshodhan (2020) ke anusaar Lok Sabha mein Anglo-Indian samuday ke liye nominated 2 sadasya (Article 331 wali vyavastha) ko samapt kar diya gaya, aur anusaar se silasag (total) sadasyata 543 nirvachan-yogya (directly elected) aur 550 tak uchchatam (maximum) ho gayi (jis cheezon mein 550 ki seema pehle bhi thi). Isi sanshodhan ne SC-ST ke liye aarakshan (reservation) ko 2030 tak badha diya. 552 wala aankda purane pravdhanon (550 + 2 nominated) ko darshata hai jo ab 104th sanshodhan ke baad badal gaye hain, isliye options mein 543 (currently elected, 550 maximum) sahi hai. Exam point: 104th sanshodhan (2020) = Lok Sabha 543 (2 nominated Anglo-Indian se hatae), maximum 550; SC-ST reservation 2030 tak.

qe: What does a 'Lame Duck Session' signify in parliamentary convention?
qh: संसद का 'लेम डक' सत्र क्या है?
o: The last session of the outgoing Lok Sabha held after elections have taken place for the new Lok Sabha
An unlisted midnight emergency sitting
The special inaugural session of a newly formed parliament
A session without formal legislative business
e: 'Lame Duck Session' (lahngda-battakh) wo antim (last) baithak (session) hoti hai jo purani (outgoing) Lok Sabha ki hoti hai jab nayi Lok Sabha ke liye chunav ho chuke hote hain lekin nayi sadan ne shapath (oath) nahi liya hota. Aise samay sadasya ke paas koi rajnitik bhavishya nahi hota isliye ve 'lahngde battakh' ki tarah hote hain, aur sadan keval zaruri kaam (jaise naye sadasyon ke liye vyavastha ya money bill) kar sakti hai. Ye 'midnight session' ya nayi parliament ki pehli baithak se alag hai - wo alag concepts hain. Exam point: Lame Duck Session = chunav ke baad, nayi Lok Sabha banne se pehle ki purani sadan ki antim baithak.

qe: Under Article 112, what constitutional term is used instead of the word 'Budget'?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 112 किससे संबंधित है और 'बजट' के लिए कौन सा शब्द प्रयोग करता है?
o: Consolidated Expenditure Bill
National Appropriation Act
Union Balance Ledger
Annual Financial Statement
e: Article 112 ke anusaar sarkar ke varshik aay-vyay (receipts and expenditure) ka vritt (statement) rashtrapati dwara sansad ke saamne pesh kiya jaata hai, jise samvidhan mein 'Annual Financial Statement' kaha gaya hai. Aam bolchaal mein ise 'Budget' kehte hain, par samvidhan mein 'Budget' shabd nahi milta. Iske teen hisse hote hain - Consolidated Fund, Contingency Fund aur Public Account wale kharch. Niti-sambandhi (policy) taur par budget ke teen khadan (parts) hote hain - Revenue Account (aay-vyay), Capital Account aur iske alava deficit ke anka. Exam point: Budget ka samvidhanik naam = Annual Financial Statement (Article 112), jo rashtrapati ke naam se pesh hota hai.

qe: Under Article 101(4), after how many consecutive days of unauthorized absence does an MP vacate their seat?
qh: एक सांसद अपनी सीट खो देता है यदि वह बिना अनुमति के कितने समय तक अनुपस्थित रहता है?
o: 6 calendar months
90 days
60 consecutive days without permission of the House
30 continuous days
e: Article 101(4) ke anusaar koi bhi MP (Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha ka sadasya) apni seat se tab haT jaata hai jab wo sadan ki anumati ke bina lagatar 60 din tak baithak mein upasthit na ho. 'Consecutive' (lagatar) shabd ahem hai - beech mein ek din bhi upasthit ho gaya to ginti dobara shuru hoti hai, aur ye 60 din sadan ki baithak ke din gine jaate hain (chhutti ke din nahi). Iske alava sadasya anuchchhed (defection), dwi-sadasyata (office of profit) ya party chhodne par bhi seat kho sakta hai. Exam point: 60 din lagatar (consecutive) bina chhutti ke anupasthiti = seat khaali (Article 101(4)).

qe: Under Article 64, who acts as the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha)?
qh: राज्यसभा का 'पदेन सभापति' कौन होता है?
o: The Vice-President of India
An elected senior member of the House
The President of India
The Chief Justice of India
e: Article 64 ke anusaar Bharat ka Uparashtrapati (Vice-President) hi 'Council of States' (Rajya Sabha) ka padhin (ex-officio) Adhyaksh (Chairman) hota hai - matlab wo usi vajah se Chairman ban jaata hai kyunki wo Uparashtrapati hai, alag se us pad ke liye chuna nahi jaata. Rajya Sabha ke sadasyon mein se ek 'Deputy Chairman' chuna jaata hai jo Uparashtrapati ki gairhaazri mein sadan ki adhyakshta karta hai. Rashtrapati, mukhya nyayadhish ya koi senior sadasya is adhyakshta ke liye nahi hai; ye vyavastha America ke Uparashtrapati wale model par aadharit hai. Exam point: Rajya Sabha ka padhin Chairman = Uparashtrapati (Article 64); Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Chairman) Rajya Sabha ke sadasyon se chuna jaata hai.

qe: When is 'Question Hour' conducted during the standard daily sittings of Parliament?
qh: 'प्रश्नकाल' आमतौर पर कब आयोजित किया जाता है?
o: During the post-lunch legislative session
During the final hour before adjournment
The very first hour of every parliamentary sitting (11:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
At 12:00 Noon during Zero Hour
e: Question Hour sansad ki pratyek baithak ke pehle ghante (11:00 AM se 12:00 Noon) chalti hai, jismein sadasya sat ya asa prashn (starred/unstarred) ke through mantriyon se jaankari maangte hain aur unke jawab paate hain. Sat (1) prashn wale prashnon (starred question) ka jawab maukhik aur anuparik (supplementary) sawaalon ke saath hota hai; tara-rahit (unstarred) prashn ka jawab likhit (written) mein diya jaata hai. Ye samay sansad ke karya ka sabse ahem hissa hai kyunki isse sarkar ki jawabdehi (accountability) tay hoti hai aur janta ko pata chalta hai ki sarkar kya kar rahi hai. Zero Hour iske baad 12 baje shuru hoti hai. Exam point: Question Hour = pehla ghanta (11 AM-12 Noon); Zero Hour = uske baad (12 baje).

qe: Which type of bill can originate in either House but cannot be referred to a Joint Sitting in case of deadlock?
qh: कौन सा विधेयक किसी भी सदन में शुरू हो सकता है लेकिन इसके लिए 'संयुक्त बैठक' का प्रावधान नहीं है?
o: State boundary reorganization bills
Ordinary legislative bills
Constitutional Amendment Bill under Article 368
Financial Bill Category I
e: Samvidhan sanshodhan vidheyak (Constitutional Amendment Bill, Article 368) dono sadanon mein se kisi bhi sadan mein prastut kiya ja sakta hai, lekin deadlock hone par sanmilit baithak (joint sitting) nahi hoti. Iske liye har sadan mein alag se vishesh bahumat (special majority - kul sadasyon ka bahumat + upasthit evam matdan wale sadasyon ka 2/3) chahiye; kuchh sanshodhan ke liye aadhe rajyaon ke vidhan mandalon ka anumodan (ratification) bhi chahiye. Isi karan samvidhan sanshodhan Rajya Sabha dwara ruk sakta hai, par us par joint sitting se faisla nahi ho sakta - yahi iski khaas baat hai. Exam point: Article 368 wala vidheyak - dono sadanon mein prastut ho sakta hai, par Joint Sitting nahi hoti (special majority + ratification zaroori).

qe: Under Lok Sabha Rules, who nominates the 'Panel of Chairpersons' to preside over the House in the absence of Speaker and Deputy Speaker?
qh: लोकसभा में 'सभापति तालिका' का नामांकन किसके द्वारा किया जाता है?
o: The President of India
The Minister of Parliamentary Affairs
The Prime Minister as Leader of the House
The Speaker of the Lok Sabha (not more than 10 members)
e: Lok Sabha ke Niyam (Rules of Procedure) ke anusaar Adhyaksh (Speaker) 'Panel of Chairpersons' (adhyakshta-mandal) naamit karte hain, jismein adhiktam 10 sadasya hote hain. Jab Speaker aur Deputy Speaker dono absent hon, inmein se koi ek sadasya sadan ki adhyakshta karta hai. Ye panel sadan ke kaam ko nirvighn (uninterrupted) chalane ke liye hota hai, aur Speaker kisi bhi samay is panel mein badlav kar sakte hain. Adhyakshta-mandal ke sadasya agenda (kaaryasuchi) nahi banate, sirf baithak ki adhyakshta karte hain. Exam point: Panel of Chairpersons = Speaker dwara nominated, adhiktam 10 sadasya (Speaker/Deputy Speaker ki anupasthiti mein adhyakshta ke liye).

qe: What core protections are provided to Members of Parliament under Article 105 regarding Parliamentary Privileges?
qh: अनुच्छेद 105 के तहत सांसदों को विशेषाधिकारों के संबंध में क्या सुरक्षा प्रदान की गई है?
o: Absolute freedom of speech in Parliament, with immunity from court proceedings for anything said or any vote given in the House
Permanent diplomatic passports for private travels
Immunity from criminal arrests under preventive detention statutes
Complete exemption from personal income taxation
e: Article 105 sansad ke sadasyon ko sansadiya visheshadhikar (parliamentary privileges) deta hai - sabse ahem yahi ki sadan ke andar kahi gayi kisi bhi baat ya diye gaye kisi bhi vote ke liye kisi bhi adalat (court) mein karyavahi nahi ki ja sakti, aur unki abhivyakti ki poori swatantrata hoti hai. Lekin dhyaan rahe - ye chhoot (immunity) sirf sansad ke andar ki baaton aur karya ke liye hai; criminal offender ko bhi sadan ke andar bhashan ke aadhar par nahi pakda ja sakta, par sadan ke bahar ki karyavahi par ye sansaddh (protection) nahi milti. Iske alava sansad ko apni karyavahi ke record (proceedings) publish karne ki swatantrata bhi hai. Exam point: Article 105 = sansad mein bhashan aur vote ke liye court se chhoot (immunity) + abhivyakti ki swatantrata; koi permanent diplomatic passport ya tax chhoot nahi.

qe: What is the maximum sanctioned strength of the Rajya Sabha as laid down in Article 80?
qh: राज्यसभा की अधिकतम सदस्य संख्या कितनी है?
o: 543 members
250 members (238 representing States/UTs + 12 nominated by President)
300 members
245 members
e: Article 80 ke anusaar Rajya Sabha ki adhiktam (maximum) sadasyata 250 hai - jismein 238 sadasya rajyaon aur sangh kshetron (UTs) ke pratinidhi hote hain (vidhan sabhaon dwara chune gaye) aur 12 sadasya rashtrapati dwara saahitya, vigyan, kala aur samaj-seva ke kshetra mein naamit (nominated) hote hain. Aaj karyatah Rajya Sabha mein 245 sadasya hain (233 + 12), kyunki kuchh UT (jaise Delhi, Puducherry) ka pratinidhitva aata hai. 543 Lok Sabha ka anka hai, 300 ya 245 uchchatam (maximum) nahi hain. Exam point: Rajya Sabha = 250 maximum (238 + 12 nominated); aaj 245 (233 + 12).

qe: Which of the following bodies is an Executive Cabinet Committee rather than a Standing Parliamentary Committee?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक संसदीय समिति नहीं बल्कि कार्यकारी कैबिनेट समिति है?
o: Committee on Public Undertakings
Estimates Committee
Public Accounts Committee
Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)
e: File mein diye gaye teenon (Public Accounts Committee, Estimates Committee, COPU) sansad ki sthayi samitiyan (standing parliamentary committees) hain, jo hi sansad ke sadasyon se bantee hain. Lekin 'Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs' (CCEA) sansad ki committee nahi, balki mantri-parishad (executive) ki samiti hai, jismein keval mantri (ministers) hote hain. Isliye ye vikalp sahi hai. Isi tarah Cabinet Committee on Security, Cabinet Committee on Political Affairs aadi executive-level samitiyan hain; ye sansad se jawabdeh rah sakti hain par unke sadasya sansad ke sadasy nahi hote. Exam point: CCEA = executive (cabinet) committee; PAC, Estimates, COPU = parliamentary (standing) committees.

qe: What does the procedure known as 'Guillotine' denote in the passage of the Annual Budget?
qh: बजट प्रक्रिया में 'गिलोटिन' क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The voluntary surrender of department grants
Putting all undiscovered and remaining demands for grants to vote immediately on the final allotted day without further discussion
The suspension of the session due to fiscal deficit
The complete rejection of the Finance Bill by the Speaker
e: 'Guillotine' parliament ki financial karyavahi ki ek vidhi hai: Annual Budget par samanya bahas (general discussion) ke baad jab allocated din khatm ho jaate hain aur bahut se demands (praantik maang) par bahas baki reh jaati hai, to Adhyaksh (Speaker) un sabhi maangon ko, jo bahas ke bina bachi hain, ek saath matdan (voting) ke liye rakh dete hain. Isse budget ka kaam (financial business) samay par poora ho jaata hai, chahe poori charcha na ho payi ho. Ye 'guillotine' shabd French kraanti ke aala (machine) se aaya hai, jo ek hi baar mein bahut kuchh kaat deta tha. Exam point: Guillotine = budget ke bache hue demands ko bina charcha ek saath matdan mein daalna (samay bachane ke liye).

qe: A 'Privilege Motion' can be moved by a Member of Parliament against whom?
qh: 'विशेषाधिकार प्रस्ताव' संसद में किसके खिलाफ लाया जा सकता है?
o: The Chief Justice of India
The Comptroller and Auditor General
The President of India directly
A Minister who has committed a breach of privilege by withholding facts or giving wrong information
e: Privilege Motion (visheshadhikar prastav) kisi bhi sadasya (MP) dwara tab utaaya ja sakta hai jab kisi vyakti - jaise koi mantri (minister) - ne jaanbujh kar suchna chhupakar ya galat soochna dekar sadan ke visheshadhikar (privilege) ka bhang (breach) kiya ho. Is prastav par sadan ke adhyaksh ka nirnay hota hai ki privilege ka bhang hua hai ya nahi; agar haan, to sadan karyavahi (jaise maafi maangna ya ninda) kar sakti hai. Rashtrapati, mukhya nyayadhish ya CAG ke khilaf aise prastav ka seedha sambandh nahi hota kyunki unke liye alag samvidhanik vyavastha hai. Exam point: Privilege Motion = mantri/vyakti par visheshadhikar bhang ka aarop (jaise jaanbujh kar galat jaankari dena).

qe: Who functions as the 'Leader of the House' in the Rajya Sabha?
qh: राज्यसभा में 'सदन का नेता' कौन होता है?
o: The Leader of Opposition in the House
The Vice-President of India
The Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha
The Prime Minister (if a member of RS) or a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister
e: Rajya Sabha mein 'Leader of the House' (sadan ke neta) wo hote hain jo Pradhan Mantri ho aur Rajya Sabha ke sadasya hon; agar Pradhan Mantri Lok Sabha ke sadasya hain, to Pradhan Mantri apne kisi mantri (jo Rajya Sabha ka sadasya hai) ko Leader of the House naamit karte hain. Ye pad sarkari karya-suchi (business) tay karne aur sadan mein sarkar ki raay rakhne ke liye hota hai. Uparashtrapati (Vice-President) to sadan ke Chairman hote hain (us pad se), Deputy Chairman sadan dwara chune jaate hain, aur Leader of Opposition vipaksh ka neta hota hai - teeno alag-alag pad hain. Exam point: Leader of the House (Rajya Sabha) = Pradhan Mantri (yadi RS ke sadasya hon) ya unke dwara naamit mantri.

qe: What is the procedural difference between a 'Censure Motion' and a 'No-Confidence Motion'?
qh: 'निंदा प्रस्ताव' और 'अविश्वास प्रस्ताव' में क्या प्रक्रियात्मक अंतर है?
o: Censure motion must state specific reasons/policies being censured against an individual minister or cabinet, and its passage does not mandate immediate resignation of the government
Censure motion can be introduced only in the Rajya Sabha
Both motions lead to the automatic dissolution of Parliament
Censure motion requires no reasons, while no-confidence motion requires detailed grounds
e: Censure Motion (ninda prastav) aur No-Confidence Motion mein ye mukhya antar hai ki Censure Motion mein tulna ke khaas karan tay karne padte hain - yani kis niti ya kis karyavahi ke liye ninda ki ja rahi hai (yah individual mantri bhi ho sakta hai, ya mantri-parishad bhi). No-Confidence Motion mein koi karan likhne ki zaroorat nahi hoti, keval ye vishwas jataaya jaata hai ki sadan ko sarkar par vishwas nahi hai. Censure Motion paas hone par sarkar ka turant istifa (resignation) zaruri nahi hota (par rajnitik dabaav banta hai), jabki No-Confidence Motion paas hone par mantri-parishad ko istifa dena padta hai. Dono keval Lok Sabha mein aate hain aur No-Confidence ke liye 50 sadasyon ka samarthan chahiye. Exam point: Censure = khaas karan likhna zaruri, istifa zaruri nahi; No-Confidence = koi karan nahi, paas hone par istifa zaruri.

qe: Under the Tenth Schedule (Anti-Defection Law), a Member of Parliament incurs disqualification if:
qh: 10वीं अनुसूची के तहत एक सांसद को अयोग्य घोषित किया जा सकता है यदि:
o: An independently elected member joins any political party after election
All of the above grounds
He votes or abstains from voting contrary to party whip without prior permission
He voluntarily gives up the membership of his political party
e: Dusri anusuchi (Tenth Schedule - anti-defection law, 1985 mein joda gaya) ke anusaar sadasya (MP/MLA) in teen karnon se nirhrit (disqualified) ho jaata hai: (1) swaichchhik roop se apni rajnitik party ki sadasyata chhod de, (2) party ke whip ke virodh mein vote kare ya matdan se door rahe (bina pehle anumati ke), aur (3) nirvachit swatantra sadasya (independent) chunav ke baad kisi party mein shaamil ho jaaye ya nominated sadasya 6 mahine ke andar kisi party mein shaamil ho jaaye. Iske aadhar par sadasya ki sadasyata samapt ho jaati hai; faisla sadan ke adhyaksh (Speaker/Chairman) karte hain. Exam point: Tenth Schedule (Anti-defection) = party chhodna + whip ke virodh vote + swatantra sadasya ka party mein shaamil hona - teeno karan (Article 102/191 se juda).

qe: What is the 'Rule of Lapse' in parliamentary financial administration?
qh: भारतीय संसद में 'व्यपगत का नियम' (Rule of Lapse) क्या है?
o: Ordinances expire within 30 days of presidential proclamation
Bills pending in Rajya Sabha lapse automatically after 1 year
Any unspent balance of the financial grant voted by Parliament lapses to the Consolidated Fund on the expiration of the financial year (March 31)
Speaker's executive ruling lapses when a new session begins
e: 'Rule of Lapse' sansad ki vittiya vyavastha (financial administration) ka niyam hai - us ke anusaar jitna kharch sansad dwara diya gaya (voted grant) use vitta-varsh (financial year) khatm hone par (31 March) us ka bacha hua hissa samapt ho jaata hai aur wapas Consolidated Fund of India (Bharat ka sammilit nidhi) mein chala jaata hai. Iska matlab hai ki grant ko agle saal ke liye aage nahi badhaya ja sakta; uske liye nayi maang (demand) aur nayi vitta vidheyak (Appropriation) chahiye. Ye niyam sarkari kharch ko niyantran mein rakhne aur sajaag vyavhaar sikhane ke liye hai. Admission: ye niyam general grants par lagu hota hai, kuchh special cases (jaise capital projects ke liye guarantee) alag hote hain. Exam point: Rule of Lapse = 31 March ko bacha hua grant khatm, agle saal nayi maang zaroori.

qe: Under Article 102, who decides questions regarding the statutory disqualification of an MP (other than defection)?
qh: दलबदल के अलावा सांसदों की अन्य अयोग्यताओं पर अंतिम निर्णय कौन लेता है?
o: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha alone
The President of India, acting in accordance with the binding opinion of the Election Commission
The Supreme Court of India via direct writ
The Prime Minister in Council
e: Article 102 ke anusaar kisi MP ki nirhrit (disqualification, anti-defection ke alava) par antim nirnay Rashtrapati ka hota hai, lekin wo nirnay nirvACHan aayog (Election Commission) ki raay (opinion) ke anusaar hi karna hota hai - yani Election Commission ki raay Rashtrapati par baandhne wali (binding) hoti hai. Question khud sadasya ke khilaf koi bhi vyakti ya sadan ka adhyaksh utha sakta hai, par faisla Rashtrapati karte hain. Isi tarah MLA ke liye Article 192 ke teht Rajyapal (Governor) nirnay karte hain (Election Commission ki raay se). Adalat (court) ka seedha interference nahi hota. Exam point: MP disqualification (anti-defection ke alava) = Rashtrapati, Election Commission ki binding raay ke anusaar (Article 102).

qe: Which of the following bills does NOT require the prior recommendation of the President before being introduced in Parliament?
qh: इनमें से किस विधेयक को संसद में पेश करने से पहले राष्ट्रपति की पूर्व सिफारिश की आवश्यकता नहीं होती?
o: Constitutional Amendment Bill under Article 368
Financial Bill Category I
Bill altering State boundaries under Article 3
Money Bill under Article 117(1)
e: Article 368 wala samvidhan sanshodhan vidheyak hi wo vidheyak hai jise prastut karne ke liye rashtrapati ki purv-sifarish (prior recommendation) ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Iske vipreet Money Bill (Article 117(1)), Financial Bill Category I aur Article 3 wala rajya-kshetra punargathan (State boundary alteration) vidheyak - in sab ko prastut karne se pehle rashtrapati ki sifarish lena zaroori hai. Samvidhan sanshodhan par rashtrapati ki sifarish nahi chahiye kyunki ise sadanon ke sadasyon khud apni shakti se laate hain; par sanshodhan paas hone ke baad rashtrapati ki anumati (assent) zaroor chahiye. Exam point: rashtrapati ki purv-sifarish ki zaroorat nahi = Article 368 vidheyak (samvidhan sanshodhan); Money Bill/Financial Bill/Article 3 ke liye zaroori hai.

qe: Under Article 266, how can money be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund of India?
qh: अनुच्छेद 266 के तहत भारत की संचित निधि से धन कैसे निकाला जा सकता है?
o: Only under the authority of an Appropriation Act passed by Parliament under Article 114
By an executive notification of the Union Finance Minister
Through a resolution of the Public Accounts Committee
Through a direct decree issued by the Comptroller and Auditor General
e: Article 266 ke anusaar Bharat ki Consolidated Fund (sammilit nidhi) se koi bhi paisa nikalna (withdraw) tabhi ho sakta hai jab wo sansad dwara paas kiye gaye 'Appropriation Act' (Article 114) ke teht ho. Iska matlab hai ki sarkar apni marzi se fund nahi nikaal sakti - iske liye teen kadam zaroori hain: (1) varshik vittiya vivran (Annual Financial Statement), (2) sansad dwara vyay (grants) ki manzoori aur (3) Appropriation Bill paas karke Legal Approval + (4) rashtrapati ki anumati. Iske alava vitta mantri ki adhisochna ya CAG ka aadesh aise paise nikaalne ka aadhar nahi ban sakta. Exam point: Consolidated Fund se paisa nikalne ka aadhar = Appropriation Act (Article 114); sarkar khud se paisa nahi nikaal sakti.

qe: What is a 'Point of Order' in parliamentary procedure?
qh: संसद में 'औचित्य का प्रश्न' (Point of Order) क्या है?
o: An intervention raised by a member alleging that the proceedings of the House are violating its constitutional or procedural rules
A notice for moving an adjournment motion
A formal request to extend the Question Hour
A motion to initiate voting on a government bill
e: 'Point of Order' ek saansadiya prakriya (procedure) hai jismein koi bhi sadasya (MP) is aashanka (allegation) ke saath uth khada hota hai ki sadan ki kaaryavahi samvidhan ya sadan ke niyamon (Rules) ka ullanghan kar rahi hai. Ise 'point of order' kehelne ka karan yahi hai ki ye sadan ke 'order' (vyavastha) ke bare mein hai. Is par nirnay sadan ke adhyaksh (Speaker/Chairman) ka hota hai - agar wo sahi paayein to sadan ko niyamon ke anusaar chalaya jaata hai. Ye koi vidheyak (bill) ya adjournment motion nahi hai, aur isse kisi bhi samay sadan ki karyavahi roki ja sakti hai. Exam point: Point of Order = niyamon/samvidhan ke ullanghan ka sawaal utha kar vyavastha (order) banane ka upay; faisla adhyaksh ka.

qe: Under Article 114, what is the core purpose of introducing an 'Appropriation Bill'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 114 के तहत 'विनियोग विधेयक' पेश करने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To adjust salaries of judicial magistrates
To impose fresh corporate and personal taxes
To provide the legal authorization for withdrawing money from the Consolidated Fund of India to meet voted demands for grants and charged expenditures
To borrow money from international financial institutions
e: Appropriation Bill (Article 114) sansad ke kharchon ko kanooni anumati (statutory authority) deta hai - isse sarkar ko Consolidated Fund of India se paisa nikaalne ki vidhik (legal) shakti milti hai, taaki jansankhya ke liye tay kiye gaye vyay (grants) aur 'charged expenditure' (jaise rashtrapati, nyayapalika, CAG ke kharch) dono ke liye paisa mil sake. Ye bill Money Bill ki tarah keval Lok Sabha mein aata hai, us par Rajya Sabha sanshodhan nahi kar sakti (sirf sifarish), aur iske bina sarkar ek rupaya bhi kharch nahi kar sakti. Tax lagana alag vidheyak (Finance Bill) se hota hai. Exam point: Appropriation Bill = Consolidated Fund se paisa nikalne ki anumati (Article 114); iska paas hona sarkari kharch ka aadhar.

qe: Under Article 116, what is the constitutional mechanism of 'Vote on Account'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 116 के तहत 'लेखानुदान' (Vote on Account) का संवैधानिक तंत्र क्या है?
o: A special overdraft granted by the Reserve Bank of India
An advance grant made by the Lok Sabha to cover estimated expenditure for a part of the financial year pending the completion of the budget voting process
Voting on the complete annual financial statement
A loan sanctioned directly by the Comptroller and Auditor General
e: 'Vote on Account' (Article 116) Lok Sabha dwara diya gaya ek adhikaar (advance grant) hota hai, jisse sarkar ko vitta-varsh ke kuchh hisse ke liye (aam taur par pehle do mahine) paisa kharch karne ki anumati mil jaati hai - ye tab tak ke liye hota hai jab tak budget ki poori karyavahi (grants ki manzoori + Appropriation Bill) poora na ho jaye. Iska lAbh yahi hai ki 1 April se sarkar ka kaam (salary, projects) rukta nahi. Ye Reserve Bank ka overdraft ya CAG ka loan nahi hai, aur ye Annual Financial Statement ke poore hisse par matdan nahi hota - keval ek hisse ke liye. Exam point: Vote on Account = budget poora hone tak ke liye advance grant (Article 116) - sarkar ka kaam na ruke.

qe: What is the maximum period for which the Rajya Sabha can delay or retain a Money Bill sent by the Lok Sabha?
qh: राज्यसभा लोकसभा द्वारा भेजे गए धन विधेयक को अधिकतम कितने दिनों तक रोक सकती है?
o: 30 days
14 calendar days
Until the conclusion of the ongoing session
60 days
e: Article 109 ke anusaar Money Bill Lok Sabha dwara pass hone ke baad Rajya Sabha ko bheja jaata hai, aur Rajya Sabha ke paas keval 14 din (calendar days) ka samay hota hai - is avadhi ke andar use ya to bill ko swikaar karna hota hai, ya sifarish (recommendation) ke saath wapas bhejna hota hai. Agar Rajya Sabha 14 din mein koi faisla nahi karti, to bill dono sadanon dwara paas maana jaata hai (Lok Sabha ke original roop mein). Iske alava Rajya Sabha Money Bill par sanshodhan bhi nahi kar sakti (iski sifarishen Lok Sabha ke liye mann ki baat nahi hoti). Exam point: Money Bill par Rajya Sabha ki seema = 14 din, koi sanshodhan nahi; 14 din mein jawab na dena = bill paas maana jaayega.

qe: How can the Speaker of the Lok Sabha be removed from office under Article 94?
qh: लोकसभा के अध्यक्ष को अनुच्छेद 94 के तहत कैसे हटाया जा सकता है?
o: By a resolution of the Lok Sabha passed by an effective majority of all the then members of the House, after giving 14 days notice
By an order of the President of India on Cabinet advice
By the Supreme Court on an election petition
Through an impeachment address passed by two-thirds majority of both Houses
e: Article 94 ke anusaar Lok Sabha ka Adhyaksh (Speaker) apne pad se tab haT ta hai jab Lok Sabha uske khilaf ek prastav (resolution) paas kare - is prastav ke liye 14 din ki purv soochna (notice) zaroori hai aur ye 'effective majority' (sadan ke us samay ke kul sadasyon ka bahumat) se paas hona chahiye; ye simple majority se alag hai kyunki ismein vacancy aur anupasthit sadasyon ka bhi hisaab hota hai. Rashtrapati ya Supreme Court Speaker ko hata nahi sakte, aur ye dono sadanon ki impeachment (jaisa rashtrapati ke liye hota hai) se bilkul alag hai. Speaker apna istifa Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Speaker) ko dete hain aur wo Deputy Speaker ko dete hain. Exam point: Speaker ka hatna = Lok Sabha ka resolution (14 din notice + effective majority, Article 94).

qe: Under Article 120, what is the constitutional provision regarding the language to be used in Parliament?
qh: अनुच्छेद 120 के तहत संसद में प्रयोग की जाने वाली भाषा के संबंध में क्या प्रावधान है?
o: Exclusively English in all legislative draft bills
Business shall be transacted in Hindi or in English, with the Presiding Officer empowered to permit a member to address the House in their mother tongue
Any of the 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule without permission
Strictly Hindi in Devanagari script only
e: Article 120 ke anusaar sansad ke kaam-kaar (business) Hindi ya English mein kiye ja sakte hain. Adhyaksh (Presiding Officer) ko ye shakti hai ki wo kisi sadasya ko apni maatrubhasha (mother tongue) mein bhashan dene ki anumati de sakte hain; iske alava Article 348 ke teht adalat aur vidheyakon (bills) ki bhasha English hai, aur Article 351 rashtrabhasha ke vikas ka zikr karta hai. Isliye 'strictly Hindi' ya 'exclusively English' wale vikalp galat hain. 22 bhashaen (Eighth Schedule) mein hain, par unmein bina anumati ke bhashan nahi diya ja sakta. Exam point: sansad ki bhasha = Hindi ya English (Article 120); adhyaksh ki anumati se maatrubhasha mein bhi bhashan sambhav.

qe: How many members must stand in their seats to support an 'Adjournment Motion' in the Lok Sabha before it is admitted?
qh: लोकसभा में 'स्थगन प्रस्ताव' स्वीकार किए जाने से पहले कितने सदस्यों का समर्थन आवश्यक है?
o: 50 members
100 members
One-tenth of the total house strength
25 members
e: Sthaapan (Adjournment) prastav ka maksad sadan ki samanya kaaryavahi ko rok kar kisi aakaalik (urgent) aur ahem mudde par charcha karana hota hai - aur Lok Sabha ke niyamon ke anusaar is prastav ko sweekar (admit) karne ke liye kam se kam 50 sadasyon ka khade hokar (standing) samarthan zaroori hai. Chunki ye sarkar ke kisi kaam ke khilaf sadan ka dhyan khendta hai, isliye ise sarkar ke liye 'censorship' jaisa maana jaata hai. 25, 100 ya 1/10 wale aankde galat hain. Adjournment Motion ka sambandh kisi vidhi ya samvidhan sanshodhan se nahi, balki sadan ki karyavahi ke niyantran se hai. Exam point: Adjournment Motion ke liye 50 sadasyon ka khade hokar samarthan (Lok Sabha); No-Confidence Motion ke liye bhi 50 sadasya chahiye.

qe: Which of the following bills does NOT lapse upon the dissolution of the Lok Sabha?
qh: लोकसभा के भंग होने पर कौन सा विधेयक समाप्त नहीं होता है?
o: A bill returned by the President for reconsideration
A bill originated and pending in the Rajya Sabha which has not been passed by the Lok Sabha
A bill originated in and pending in the Lok Sabha
A bill passed by the Lok Sabha but pending in the Rajya Sabha
e: Lok Sabha ke bhang (dissolution) hone par kuchh vidheyak (bills) samapt (lapse) ho jaate hain aur kuchh nahi. Lapse nahi hone wale vidheyakon mein wo vidheyak sabse ahem hai jo Rajya Sabha mein aaya aur wahan pending hai lekin Lok Sabha dwara kabhi paas nahi hua - kyunki wo Lok Sabha ke 'kaam' mein nahi aaya, isliye us par bhang ka koi asar nahi hota. Iske ulat Lok Sabha mein pending vidheyak, Lok Sabha dwara paas hokar Rajya Sabha mein pending vidheyak, aur rashtrapati ke paas punarvichar (reconsideration) ke liye gaye vidheyak - teesre Lok Sabha bhang hone par samapt ho jaate hain (rashtrapati wale par wo naya sadan us par aage vichaar kar sakta hai - rules ke anusaar). Exam point: Lok Sabha ke bhang par lapse nahi hota = Rajya Sabha mein pending vidheyak (jo Lok Sabha dwara paas na hua ho).

qe: Under Article 82, the readjustment of allocation of parliamentary seats and boundaries after every decennial census is enacted by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 82 के तहत प्रत्येक जनगणना के बाद सीटों और सीमाओं के पुनर्समायोजन को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: State-level panchayat adjustments
A direct proclamation by the Chief Election Commissioner
Delimitation enacted by Parliament by Law
A presidential decree on the advice of the Supreme Court
e: Article 82 ke anusaar pratyek janganana (census) ke baad rajyaon ko Lok Sabha ki seetaun (seats) ka punar-vitaran (reallocation) aur simaon (boundaries) ka punarnirdharan 'Delimitation' dwara hota hai, jise sansad kanoon banakar (Parliament by law) karti hai. Isi ke teht 2002 mein Delimitation Commission bani thi, jiska kaam rajyon ki seetaun aur kshetra (constituencies) ki simayein tay karna tha - par jansankhya ke aadhar par seetaun badhane (increase) par 2026 tak rok lagi hai (84th sanshodhan). Rajya-panchayat, rashtrapati ka aadesh ya CEC is kaam ko nahi karte. Exam point: delimitation = sansad ka kanoon (Article 82) ke teht; Delimitation Commission simaon ka nirdharan karti hai.

qe: What does a 'Calling Attention Motion' achieve in the Indian parliamentary system?
qh: संसद में 'ध्यानाकर्षण प्रस्ताव' (Calling Attention Motion) का क्या कार्य होता है?
o: It allows a member to call the attention of a Minister to an urgent matter of public importance and seek an authoritative statement
It demands the resignation of the Council of Ministers
It suspends the Question Hour indefinitely
It refers a pending bill to a joint committee
e: 'Calling Attention Motion' ek aisi sansadiya vidhi hai jismein koi sadasya kisi aakaalik (urgent) jan-hit (public importance) ke mudde par mantri ka dhyaan aakarshit (call the attention) karta hai aur unse tatkaal ek aadhikarik (authoritative) vaktavya (statement) maangta hai. Ye motion Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha dono mein istemal hoti hai, aur ismein mantri ki jawabdehi (accountability) sadan ke saamne tay hoti hai. Isse sarkar ka istifa nahi maanga jaata, na Question Hour suspend hoti hai aur na koi vidheyak samiti ko bheja jaata hai - ye keval jaankari ka zariya hai. Exam point: Calling Attention Motion = mantri ka dhyaan aakarshit kar tatkaal aadhikarik vaktavya maangna (urgent jan-hit ke mudde par).

qe: In which historic year was the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) first constituted?
qh: राज्यसभा का गठन पहली बार किस वर्ष किया गया था?
e: Rajya Sabha (Council of States) ka gathan (constitution) pehli baar April 1952 mein hua tha - pehle Lok Sabha ke chunav (1951-52) ke baad. 1950 mein rajya sabha nahi bani thi; us saal 26 January ko samvidhan lagu hua aur us samay keval samvidhan sabha (Constituent Assembly) hi kaam kar rahi thi, jo 1952 tak sansad ke roop mein bhi chalti rahi; phir 1952 ke chunav ke baad nayi sansad bani. Isliye Rajya Sabha ka pehla satr (session) May 1952 mein hua. Exam point: Rajya Sabha ki sthapna = April 1952 (pehla general election 1951-52 ke baad); Lok Sabha ka pehla satr bhi 1952 mein hua.

qe: What is the statutory composition of the Committee on Public Undertakings (COPU)?
qh: 'सार्वजनिक उपक्रम समिति' (COPU) में कितने सदस्य होते हैं?
o: 10 members nominated by the President
22 members (15 from Lok Sabha and 7 from Rajya Sabha)
30 members from Lok Sabha only
15 members from Lok Sabha only
e: 'Committee on Public Undertakings' (COPU) ka gathan (composition) 22 sadasya ka hota hai - 15 Lok Sabha se aur 7 Rajya Sabha se, jinhe sadan ke niyam ke anusaar chuna jaata hai. Iska kaam sarkari upkramon (public undertakings - jaise BHEL, SAIL) ki karyapranali, vittiya sthiti aur prabandhan (management) ki jaanch karna hai, aur ise PAC/CAG ki reports ka sahyog bhi milta hai. Iska adhyakshta (chairmanship) Lok Sabha ke sadasya ke paas hota hai (rotation ke anusaar). 30 sadasya Estimates Committee ka hota hai (keval Lok Sabha), aur 15/10 wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: COPU = 22 sadasya (15 LS + 7 RS); PAC ka bhi 22 (15+7); Estimates = 30 (keval LS).

qe: Under the Lok Sabha Rules of Procedure, what is the minimum membership support required to admit a 'No-Confidence Motion'?
qh: लोकसभा में 'अविश्वास प्रस्ताव' स्वीकार करने के लिए कितने सदस्यों के समर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: 25 members
100 members
50 members standing in their seats
10 members
e: Avishvash prastav (No-Confidence Motion) Lok Sabha mein tab hi sweekar (admit) kiya jaata hai jab uske paksh mein kam se kam 50 sadasya apni seat par khade hokar samarthan dene ki iccha jataayein - ye shart sansad ke niyamon (Rules of Procedure) mein di gayi hai. Iske baad Adhyaksh tithi (date) tay karte hain aur us par charcha hoti hai; agar ye bahumat se paas ho jaaye to mantri-parishad (Council of Ministers) ko istifa dena padta hai. 25, 100 ya 10 sadasya wale aankde galat hain. Dhyaan rahe - sadaant (Adjournment) prastav ke liye bhi 50 sadasyon ka samarthan chahiye, par dono prastav ke maksad aur asar alag-alag hote hain. Exam point: No-Confidence Motion = 50 sadasyon ka khade hokar samarthan (keval Lok Sabha), paas hone par sarkar ka istifa zaroori.

qe: What is the constitutional significance of Article 100(1) regarding the 'Casting Vote' of the Presiding Officer?
qh: अनुच्छेद 100(1) के तहत पीठासीन अधिकारी के 'निर्णायक मत' (Casting Vote) का क्या महत्व है?
o: The Speaker votes first on all constitutional amendment bills
The Speaker can cast a proxy vote on behalf of absent MPs
The Speaker has two votes on financial bills
The Speaker or Chairman does not vote in the first instance, but exercises a casting vote in the case of an equality of votes (tie)
e: Article 100(1) ke anusaar sadan ka adhyaksh (Speaker/Chairman) pehle (in the first instance) vote nahi deta - wo keval tabhi vote deta hai jab matdan (votes) barabar ho jayen (equality of votes), taaki kisi ek paksh ko nirnayak labh na mile. Ise 'casting vote' kehte hain, jo adhyaksh ke tatasth (neutral) rahne ki parampara ko darshata hai. Iske alava adhyaksh ka koi do-teen vote ya proxy vote nahi hota; wo keval barabari todne ke liye vote dene ka adhikar rakhata hai. Iske ulta Lok Sabha mein Money Bill par faisla to speaker ke hi paas hota hai (Article 110) - dono par sahuliyat ke liye dhyan rakhna chahiye. Exam point: Speaker/Chairman ka casting vote = keval tie (barabari) hone par (Article 100).

qe: Under Article 98, what structural protection is provided to the Secretariats of both Houses of Parliament?
qh: अनुच्छेद 98 के तहत संसद के दोनों सदनों के सचिवालयों को क्या सुरक्षा दी गई है?
o: Each House of Parliament shall have a separate secretarial staff independent of the Executive
All parliamentary clerks are appointed by the Union Public Service Commission
Secretaries are subordinate to the Prime Minister's Office
The secretarial staff is common and managed by the Ministry of Home Affairs
e: Article 98 ke anusaar sansad ke dono sadanon (Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha) ke apne-alag secretarial staff (sachivalaya-karmachari) hote hain, jo karyapalika (executive) se swatantra (independent) hote hain. Iska matlab hai ki dono sadan apne karmachariyon ki bharti, niyukti aur seva-shartein khud tay kar sakti hain, aur wo kisi mantralaya (ministry) ke adheen nahi hote. Yahi swatantra vyavastha sadanon ki kaaryaswastata (efficiency) aur vaastavik swatantrata ke liye zaroori hai. Iske alava Article 98 dono sadan ke sadasyon ke samanya karyon ke liye sansad kanoon bana sakti hai. Exam point: Article 98 = dono sadanon ka alag aur swatantra sachivalaya-staff (executive se alag).

qe: Under Article 3, who holds the constitutional power to form new States and alter the areas, boundaries, or names of existing States?
qh: अनुच्छेद 3 के तहत नए राज्य बनाने या मौजूदा राज्यों की सीमाओं को बदलने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: Parliament by Law (passed by a simple majority)
The Supreme Court through territorial arbitration
The concerned State Legislative Assemblies by special resolution
The Inter-State Council with presidential approval
e: Article 3 ke anusaar naye rajya banane, kisi rajya ka kshetra badalne, seema (boundaries) ya naam badalne ki shakti sansad ke paas hai, jo sadharan bahumat (simple majority) se kanoon bana kar istemal hoti hai. Par iske liye do shart rakhhi gayi hain: (1) rashtrapati ki purv-sifarish (approval) leni hoti hai, aur (2) rashtrapati us vidheyak ko sambandhit rajya ke vidhan mandal ki raay (opinion) ke liye bhejta hai - ye raay baandhne wali (binding) nahi hoti, par suni jaati hai. Isi tarah 1956 mein States Reorganisation Act banakar rajyaon ka punargathan hua, aur aaj Uttarakhand, Jharkhand, Telangana jaise rajya bane. Exam point: Article 3 = naye rajya/naam/seema mein parivartan sansad ke sadharan kanoon se (rajya ki raay binding nahi, rashtrapati ki sifarish zaroori).

qe: Under Article 87, when is the President constitutionally required to deliver an address to both Houses of Parliament assembled together?
qh: अनुच्छेद 87 के तहत राष्ट्रपति के लिए संसद के दोनों सदनों को एक साथ संबोधित करना कब अनिवार्य है?
o: Only during joint sittings called to resolve legislative deadlocks
At the commencement of the first session after each general election to the Lok Sabha and at the commencement of the first session of each year
At the end of every fiscal financial quarter
At the commencement of every parliamentary sitting
e: Article 87 ke anusaar rashtrapati ka aabhaashan (address) dono sadanon ki sanmilit baithak mein do maukon (occasions) par anivarya (required) hota hai: (1) aam chunav (general election) ke baad Lok Sabha ki pehli satr (session) ke aarambh mein, aur (2) pratyek varsh (year) ki pehli baithak ke aarambh mein. Is aabhaashan mein rashtrapati sarkar ki niti aur karyakram (programs) ka ullekh karte hain, jo mantri-parishad dwara taiyaar kiya jaata hai. Iske alava rashtrapati kabhi-kabhi vishesh (special) maukon par bhi bhashan de sakte hain, par samvidhan mein ye do mauke hi tay hain. Exam point: rashtrapati ka aabhaashan = chunav ke baad pehli satr + varsh ke pahle satr (Article 87); mantri-parishad ke dwara tayaar. ke sadasya bhashan ke liye yaaad (dhyan) rakhna hai.

qe: Article 122 of the Constitution explicitly places which barrier on the jurisdiction of courts regarding Parliament?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 122 संसद के संबंध में अदालतों के अधिकार क्षेत्र पर क्या रोक लगाता है?
o: Judges cannot cite parliamentary debates in judgments
Courts cannot punish members of parliament for treason
The validity of any proceedings in Parliament shall not be called in question in any court on the ground of any alleged irregularity of procedure
Courts cannot interpret legislation passed by Parliament
e: Article 122 ke anusaar sansad ki karyavahi (proceedings) ki vaidhata (validity) ko kisi bhi adalat (court) mein is aadhar par aadesh (challenge) nahi kiya ja sakta ki usmein karyapranali (procedure) ki koi aniyamita (irregularity) thi. Iska arth hai ki court sansad ke andar ki karyavahi mein hastakshep nahi kar sakti; haan, court samvidhan ke teht us kanoon ki vaidhata (validity of law) ki jaanch kar sakti hai, karyavahi ki prakriya ki nahi. Isi tarah Article 212 vidhan mandalon ke liye same protection deta hai. Article 122 aur 212 raksha-kavach hain jo vidhaayika ki swatantrata ko banaye rakhte hain. Exam point: Article 122 = karyavahi ki procedural aniyamita ke aadhar par court mein sawaal nahi uthaya ja sakta (vidhaayika ki swatantrata).

qe: What is the procedure of 'Half-an-Hour Discussion' in parliamentary practice?
qh: संसदीय प्रक्रिया में 'आधे घंटे की चर्चा' क्या है?
o: A mandatory debate on foreign treaties
A discussion dedicated to passing private member resolutions
A discussion on a matter of sufficient public importance that has been the subject of a recent question (oral or written) needing further elucidation
A recess before the presentation of the Union Budget
e: 'Half-an-Hour Discussion' ek sansadiya vidhi hai jismein kisi aise mudde par charcha hoti hai jo pehle Question Hour mein aaya tha - jaise sat (starred) ya tara-rahit (unstarred) prashna ka jawab mila tha, par us par aur jaankari (further elucidation) chahiye. Iska naam 'half-an-hour' isliye hai kyunki ye aadhe ghante (ya niyam ke anusaar) tak chalti hai. Ye koi mandatory treaty debate ya private member resolution nahi hai, aur isse sarkaraki niti ki jaanch ho jaati hai. Exam point: Half-an-Hour Discussion = recent question par aage ki jaankari ke liye aadhe ghante ki charcha.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the abolition or creation of Legislative Councils in States?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्यों में विधान परिषदों के गठन या उन्मूलन का प्रावधान करता है?
o: Article 168
Article 169
Article 171
Article 174
e: Article 169 ke anusaar sansad rajyaon mein Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council) banane ya khatm karne ka kanoon bana sakti hai, agar sambandhit rajya ka vidhan sabha vishesh bahumat (special majority) se prastav paas karta hai. Iska matlab hai ki rajya ki ichha pehli shart hai aur uske baad Parliament kanoon banaati hai, par Council ka gathan Article 171 ke anusaar hota hai. Article 168 sabhi rajyaon ke liye vyavastha (legislative) ka zikr karta hai aur Article 174 satr (summon/prorogue) ka. Note ki aaj keval kuchh rajyaon mein vidhan parishad hai (jaise Bihar, UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, J&K, Andhra). Exam point: Vidhan Parishad ka banna ya khatm karna = Article 169 (rajya vidhan sabha ka prastav + sansad ka kanoon).

qe: To whom does the Speaker of the Lok Sabha submit their letter of resignation under Article 94?
qh: लोकसभा का अध्यक्ष अपना त्यागपत्र किसे सौंपता है?
o: The President of India
The Prime Minister of India
The Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha
The Chief Justice of India
e: 'Speaker ka istifa kisko diya jaata hai?' - is prashna ka jawab Article 94 mein chhupa hai: Lok Sabha ke Adhyaksh (Speaker) apna tyagpatra (resignation) Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Speaker) ke paas rakhte hain, aur isi tarah Upaadhyaksh apna istifa Speaker ke paas bhejte hain. Rashtrapati ko aisa patra dene ka koi pravdhan samvidhan mein nahi hai - rashtrapati ko sirf vidhayi (legislative) karyavahi ki suchna di jaati hai, aur adalat ya kisi anya adhikari ka is mamle mein koi role nahi hota. Isliye sahi jawab Upaadhyaksh hai, na ki rashtrapati, mukhya nyayadhish ya kisi sadasya. Exam point: Speaker ka istifa = Upaadhyaksh ke paas (Article 94); Upaadhyaksh ka istifa = Speaker ke paas.
